reviews.text: I’ll definitely be coming back. I took my super nervous pitbull here to get his nails trimmed and anal glads expressed for the first time. They were great! So fast and super nice. My boy was happy and had no issues :) also great prices! I recommend 👍🏼 …
Thank you! Kona is a very good girl! We appreciate your support.
I love this place and this team for my dig-daughter, Chihuahua, Omie. She does so well with them. They love her and it shows. I appreciate and love their positive energy always. Highly recommend!

I was referred by another pet parent and this place did not disappoint! My pet and I were treated warmly. The groomer Cesar came out to meet his 1st time puppy client. He has a great personality and interacted with my pup right away. After asking me what I wanted for my fur baby he assured me it would go great. I felt easy leaving my baby for the first time. Boy...was I impressed when he walked her out. I would recommend this place for sure. ONLY 1 DOWNSIDE...THE PARKING. It's on one way street so be ready to double park lights flashing for quick drop off and pick up. Thanks again Cesar and staff!!
Cesar is AMAZING he works so well with our baby

Now they offer self-service dog wash stations
very friendly staff, clean place, I will bring my dirty dog back.

I had a great experience at Pet Palace! My cat had a nail that was curled, and getting close to his paw pad, and the groomer was able to safely trim it. It was a much less stressful experience than taking my cat to the vet, and the price was very reasonable.

This is the only place I trust bringing my nervous dog, Bailey, for nail trims and baths. She is a bigger dog and they always talk to her and make her feel as comfortable as possible, even though she is pretty nervous/afraid in general for places like the vet/groomers. They are just so great with her and I trust them. Highly recommend!

The crew is always accommodating of our schedules and always attentive and gentle with our temperamental pooch.

Much appreciated 👏 💐 🥳
Been going here for at least a year. Great service. Appointment is automated. I get a txt and confirm. Bring my dog. Get a call. Pick her up. Easy peasy.
Thank you Eri!! You are the best!
I took my puppy for her first grooming and they took great care of her! They were kind, responsive, and reasonably priced. We will definitely be back soon!

Our dog TimTam is 3 months post op from a leg surgery and on our vet’s recommendation came here. Chie did a wonderful job and was very kind. We loved our experience here. We recommend her and Pet Palace to anyone looking for a skilled groomer that is able to accommodate mobility issues due to surgery. Keep in mind it is important to get cleared for grooming after surgery and our dog did not have any stitches since we are 3 months post op. Again so grateful for Chie!

We called before we took our dog to get a nail trim and when we got there they were CLOSED...an hour before their business hours. They need to honor their hours. We probably won't take our dog there again.

We have taken all our animals here as they are incredible.  We have had super sensitive dogs (yorkies and poodle as well as pitty), but our newest rescue is a yorkie/poodle that was skittish, but they have been incredible & his tail was happy when we take him regularly.  This is the only place to get your special babies groomed & well cared for!!!
Thank you for your continued support.

Pet Palace has been wonderful with my dachshund! When he had an ear infection, the staff let me stop by every morning to help with his medicine — and never charged me for it. They were so kind and patient every time. It’s easy to book, and they always do a fantastic job with my anxious little doxi. Highly recommend!

If I could give zero stars, I would. This was my second terrible experience here, and it will definitely be my last.

Twice now, I’ve brought my dog in for a schnauzer cut, and both times they took the easy way out and shaved him completely. Instead of taking the time and care to actually groom him, they claim his coat is “too tangled” and default to shaving. That’s not skill or care—that’s laziness.

To make matters worse, I had a 10:30am appointment today. At 10:20, I got a call saying they had overbooked and couldn’t take me—after they had specifically told me to sedate my dog with comfort meds to prepare for grooming. Because of their mistake, he spent nearly 12 hours sedated for no reason at all. That’s not just unprofessional—it’s harmful.

When I picked him up, once again shaved down, I was charged $95 for a service that was neither what I asked for nor what they promised. This place does not value pets or their owners’ time.

If you want an actual grooming experience where professionals put in the work, look elsewhere.

A 5-star rating means a lot to our small local team, even without a written note. We pay attention to every bit of feedback because it helps us know when we're on the right track with pet care and grooming. If you ever feel like sharing more about your visit, we would be glad to hear it. Hope to see you again soon!

Cesar, Pet Palace
I’ve been going to Pet Palace since they opened over 25 years ago. Cesar and his great staff are excellent at their craft! They’re the only groomers I trust with my little family.
Friendly caring staff, affordable prices, great grooming, my dog is always happy when I pick her up and they dont over book so your pet gets pampered and back home in a reasonable time frame.

Pet Palace is the best! Groomers were so kind and my 2 dogs took to them instantly (which is rare for my big boy who can be shy around strangers). Both of their cuts look fabulous. They’re very thorough with grooming my doodles’ ears and paws, which I really appreciate as it seems like some groomers just skip over the ears. Pricing was very fair and your money is well spent because they do a great job. Definitely the best groomer we’ve been to, will be back when they need their next cut!

Great dog groomers located in North Park. We took our dog, Cush, walking around NP when we stumbled upon this neighborhood dog groomers. We were last minute but they were able to take him in. Cush was a bit shy when we dropped him off to get cleaned and groomed. We were so impressed when we picked him up and he was happy and handsome!

Thank you so much for taking care of Cush. Can’t wait to come back.

Contacted the owner because I wanted to give them a second chance, Via email.
I asked him if they had gotten a guide yet and they said no.
I told him that I will buy a guide and bring it in with me it's only $20 on Amazon. I actually did buyit.
The owner states he won't be growing my dog but the girl would be happy to show me the different clipper sizes.
I told him that was very unusual because I'm not a dog groomer and I don't know what the different clipper sizes mean. Nor can I picture it tried to show it to me on the first day and I'm like I don't get it.
Some things I don't get my craps I don't understand that game and people try to teach to me forever.
This is like a game of craps with your dog.
I'm not going to go back in fact.
I'm not going to the very expensive Gabrielle f who is famous on Park avenue because I know they'll take good care of my baby and I'm willing to pay extra money for that.
They are from this place had a third and final response with I will not be grooming your dog... and I'm like I didn't ask him to groom my dog that's a weird response. Very poor customer service all around which I'm sad about because I love supporting my local businesses.
Cats needed a nail trim. Excellent work and great service
Great care for our Yorkie! Reasonable and the groomer is so friendly and gentle with Sukie. Thank you!
Great customer service! They remember my pup and take great care of him. They are fast and efficient. Highly recommend.

Considering I've never been there, I just called to make an appointment & a guy with an accent answered me with an attitude.
I decided to hang up on him after a couple of minutes talking to him.
It sucks because it's one of the closest grooming places to my house.
Good thing there's more around the area.
Friendly staff and they do a great job :)
Love this place. Have taken multiple pups and they always do great work.
This is the best dog groomer. They are meticulous with my standard poodle, he loves going there, and they are always happy to see him. Easy scheduling.
One of the few places that actually grooms cats and they always do a great job. Been coming here for years.
Great job thank you
Very nice staff and the groomer took extra care with my 10 month old yorkie poo , thank you

I’ve been taking my dog Piper here for over a year. Piper is an all white Husky Samoyed mix who you can imagine gets dirty quickly and sheds like crazy. Even though she screams the building down when she’s getting groomed, she feels very comfortable in their care and always comes home looking and smelling amazing. Pet palace is my go to groomer that always provides consistent results. 10/10 recommend to a friend!
Friendly accommodating and welcoming. They always do a great job on my little Tzu. We give them four paws up!!!
This is a fabulous grooming spot - they are super friendly, great with our dog, and have reasonable prices. Highly recommend.
Loved the self-serve wash! Thanks for the great service.
